name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.295.0 — 7.295.0 — grounding contract gains the optional testCaseScanner key: a host command listing its own test cases (<file> :: <title> or JSON with start/end) so non-JavaScript stacks resolve, count and expire cases; /spec:init profiles the runner's case shape and /spec:doctor proves the listing with count-tests --scanner-check. 7.294.0 — commit-coverage.js derives the escape-row pick from the file the root cause names (--primary), falling back to the latest review among files not landed by every other entry's top spec. 7.293.0 — The review stage's patterns leg scopes its sweep to what the diff changed: each nested file's folder, a root-level file as itself, nested folders pruned, pipeline-owned paths left out; it no longer derives scope from scope-reconcile's exception sets, which skipped every planned, realized source file. scope-reconcile --json emits the changed set. The patterns row's matches sums the sweep script's per-pattern totals instead of counting output lines and records a typed unavailability when a script prints none; the generated sweep script and this repo's print no counts when rg is absent instead of a clean zero.
